title: AutoBackupClient MITE
description: A mod that automatically backs up your MITE worlds and dat files, and deletes old backups.
body:
## What this mod can do？

This mod automatically backs up your precious save files. With it installed, you can dive into mining, exploring, and other dangerous adventures with total peace of mind.

## How to use？

You can find the backups in the following path: .minecraft\versions\1.6.4-MITE\MITE\saves\backup

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/af2bd78fe5ae8b19ecf225abbfa94c5f17c5145c.png)

You can configure the related settings in: .minecraft\versions\1.6.4-MITE\config\AutoBackupClient.json

![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4786e18fffe87b70b78072c1f94c98ee6d4a599b.png)

In-game, it will be displayed as follows:Save notifications are displayed in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8289c67aa49c4eca6a41b5de5f682db1ae48d4d3.png)

## Other Notes
You don't need to worry about auto-backups filling up your storage space. When a new backup is created, the oldest one will be automatically deleted.
